title: My Account Got Hacked
subtitle: 打給客服：改密碼、登出所有裝置、開啟兩步驟登入

sentences.en: Thank you for calling account support, how can I help you today?
sentences.zh: 感謝您致電帳號客服，今天有什麼可以為您服務的？

examples.en: I emailed customer support yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天寫信給客服。

sentences.en: Hi, I think someone has hacked my account, because my friends are getting strange messages from me.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我覺得有人盜了我的帳號，因為我朋友一直收到我傳的奇怪訊息。

highlights.note: hack「入侵、盜用」，帳號被盜最常見的說法。

examples.en: My email got hacked last year.
examples.zh: 我的電子信箱去年被盜了。

examples.en: I heard a strange noise.
examples.zh: 我聽到一個奇怪的聲音。

grammar.point: present perfect for a recent result
grammar.explanation: has hacked 用現在完成式，強調「已經被盜，現在還受影響」。

examples.en: Someone has taken my umbrella.
examples.zh: 有人拿走了我的傘。

grammar.pitfall: 不用 someone hacks，這不是習慣性動作。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to hear that, but don't worry, we'll sort it out together.
sentences.zh: 很遺憾聽到這件事，不過別擔心，我們一起把它處理好。

highlights.note: 英式／印度英文常用，「解決、處理好」。

examples.en: Let me sort out the tickets.
examples.zh: 我來處理票的事。

connected.note: 三個字連在一起，t 都輕輕帶過。

sentences.en: Can you still log in, or has the password been changed?
sentences.zh: 您還能登入嗎？還是密碼已經被改了？

examples.en: I can't log in to my account.
examples.zh: 我登入不了我的帳號。

examples.en: Don't share your password with anyone.
examples.zh: 不要把密碼告訴任何人。

grammar.explanation: has + been + 過去分詞是現在完成式被動，重點在密碼「被改了」，不在誰改的。

examples.en: Has the meeting been cancelled?
examples.zh: 會議被取消了嗎？

grammar.pitfall: 不要說 has the password changed，那會變成密碼自己改變。

sentences.en: I can still log in on my phone, but it says my laptop was signed out.
sentences.zh: 我的手機還能登入，可是它顯示我的筆電被登出了。

examples.en: Remember to sign out on shared computers.
examples.zh: 在公用電腦上記得登出。

sentences.en: Good, while you're still logged in, please change your password right away.
sentences.zh: 好，趁您還在登入狀態，請馬上更改密碼。

examples.en: Please call me right away.
examples.zh: 請馬上打給我。

connected.note: right 的 t 和 away 連讀。

sentences.en: Choose a long one that you don't use anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 選一個長一點、而且沒有在其他地方用過的密碼。

examples.en: I can't find it anywhere else.
examples.zh: 我在其他地方都找不到。

sentences.en: Okay, done. I used the same password for everything before, which was probably a mistake.
sentences.zh: 好，改好了。我以前每個地方都用同一組密碼，這大概是個錯誤。

examples.en: Everyone makes mistakes.
examples.zh: 每個人都會犯錯。

grammar.point: which referring to a whole clause
grammar.explanation: 逗號後的 which 可以指前面整句話的內容，這裡指「每個地方都用同一組密碼」這件事。

examples.en: He was late again, which made the boss angry.
examples.zh: 他又遲到了，這讓老闆很生氣。

grammar.pitfall: 不要用 that 代替這種逗號後的 which。

sentences.en: It's very common, so don't be hard on yourself.
sentences.zh: 這很常見，所以別對自己太苛刻。

examples.en: Don't be so hard on him, he's new.
examples.zh: 別對他那麼嚴，他是新來的。

sentences.en: Next, go to security settings and tap sign out of all devices.
sentences.zh: 接著，到安全性設定，點選「登出所有裝置」。

examples.en: You can use the app on any device.
examples.zh: 你可以在任何裝置上使用這個應用程式。

examples.en: Check your security settings once a month.
examples.zh: 每個月檢查一次安全性設定。

connected.note: sign、out、of、all 一路連讀，of 弱讀。

sentences.en: That will kick the hacker out, wherever they are.
sentences.zh: 這樣不管駭客在哪裡，都會被踢出去。

examples.en: The game kicked me out again.
examples.zh: 遊戲又把我踢出去了。

sentences.en: All right, I see that option. Should I turn on two-step login as well?
sentences.zh: 好，我看到那個選項了。我也應該開啟兩步驟登入嗎？

examples.en: Two-step login keeps your account safer.
examples.zh: 兩步驟登入讓你的帳號更安全。

examples.en: Can I have a coffee as well?
examples.zh: 我也可以要一杯咖啡嗎？

sentences.en: Absolutely, after that, every new login will need a code sent to your phone.
sentences.zh: 當然，設好之後，每次新的登入都需要一組傳到您手機的驗證碼。

examples.en: Enter the code we sent to your phone.
examples.zh: 輸入我們傳到你手機的驗證碼。

grammar.quote: a code sent to your phone
grammar.explanation: sent to your phone 是省略的被動關係子句（= which is sent），修飾 code。

examples.en: I read the email sent by my teacher.
examples.zh: 我讀了老師寄來的信。

grammar.pitfall: 不要寫成 a code send to your phone，要用過去分詞 sent。

sentences.en: Finally, please tell your friends not to click any links in those messages.
sentences.zh: 最後，請告訴您的朋友不要點那些訊息裡的任何連結。

examples.en: Don't click links from strangers.
examples.zh: 不要點陌生人傳來的連結。

sentences.en: I'll post a warning right now, thank you so much for your help.
sentences.zh: 我現在就發一則警告，非常謝謝您的幫忙。

examples.en: She posted a photo of her lunch.
examples.zh: 她發了一張午餐的照片。

examples.en: There's a warning on the box.
examples.zh: 盒子上有警告標示。
